- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Met is one of the world's largest and most famous museums, with a collection of over 2 million works of art spanning 5,000 years of human history.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Must-see exhibits at the Met include: The Temple of Dendur, The Great Hall, The European Wing, The American Wing, and The Impressionist and Modern Art Galleries.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips for visiting the Met include planning ahead, arriving early, taking breaks, using the Met's website and app, and taking advantage of pay-what-you-wish admission.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Other museums in NYC worth visiting include: The Museum of Modern Art (MoMA), The Guggenheim Museum, The Whitney Museum of American Art, The American Museum of Natural History, and The Frick Collection.
